text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 3

An all-male panel that selected a male candidate over you, also a man, gives you nothing. Sex discrimination claims require that your sex disadvantaged you — here every relevant party shares it. Raising it would read as grasping and undercut your credible points.

Your real grievance is substantive: you hold a doctorate in the field and eight years running a section, while the appointee has a master's and "broad leadership experience" — vague wording that invites scrutiny. And the unanswered request for written reasons is a concrete procedural failure.

Send a firm follow-up citing your original request, with a deadline. Ask specifically how the stated criteria were scored. Keep the focus on qualifications and process.
